prompt: A flat pixel-art game screen with crisp hard-edged square pixels and flat colour fills, showing a busy restaurant kitchen line from a high three-quarter angle: left to right a flat-top grill, a deep fryer, a two-burner saute station and a stainless steel pass window, with tiny white paper order tickets clipped along a rail across the top. Two line cooks about 48 pixels tall, in white jackets and black skull caps, work the line, one flipping a burger, one lifting a fry basket, with chunky pixel flames and steam puffs. Limited palette of about 24 colours: cool steel greys and deep navy tile walls lit by hot orange and yellow from the grill. Clean one-pixel dark outlines on every object, strong readable silhouettes, and a clean open floor across the lower third.
